reviews.t: and honestly I am disappointed in myself for buying something from them
reviews.x: I absolutely despise the Kardashians, and honestly I am disappointed in myself for buying something from them. I got a sample of this in my boxycharm and I really like this product. I feel it's morally irresponsible to support these knuckle-draggers and their ridonkulous empire of stupidity, but this is a lightweight hair oil and leaves my hair shiny but not weighed down and it smells nice. I'm going to hell, but I'll probably keep buying this.

Honestly, everything I know about the Kardashians, I learned from watching The Soup. I hate myself for contributing to the Vapid Empire, but I have awesome hair. It's very soft, very shiny, very silky and seems to hold up better in humid weather than ever before. Is terrific hair worth a tiny piece of my soul? In this case, I have to answer, "yep!"

This Kardashian dry black seed oil is by far the best shining/straightening oil I have ever used in my life. I am on 2 different types of chemo drugs and it has played havoc on my long hair. Kim Kardashian knows her stuff for sure! I have tried at least 30 different products to help with the frizz in my hair. I received a small sample bottle of this in a monthly subscription box I get. A small bottle of this lasted me about 4 months of daily use. I used it right after a wash while my hair was st

Wow, this stuff is impressive. I've been using morrocan oil for years but this is much better. It's much lighter, doesn't weigh the hair down. Instead of sitting on top of the hair follicles it really does seep INTO them. My ends are dry and damaged even when I cut my hair and this stuff made them look MUCH less damaged. It obviously doesn't actually fix the spilt ends but it makes them look 100 times healthier. And it smells amazing.

reviews.t: Awesome product but annoying celebrities but you want good hair right? Buy it!
reviews.x: LOVE this stuff!  It makes me normally super damaged looking hair/ends feel and look like brand new.  I don't like the Kardashians, but I'm rep a good product when I have one.  Believe me all the reviews are right.  This is an outstanding product. Not a bit sticky or slimy or I wouldn't use it.  Awesome!

So let's talk about this product. I am naturally blonde and also color my hair blond to have brighter color, also my hair is very fine and very, very, very dry. I have to co-wash, can't use harsh shampoo. I am obsessed with oils - for body, face, hair, you name it I have it or tried it. I got little sample of this oil in my monthly beauty subscription box - BOXYCHARM. I tried it and fell in love. This BLACK SEE OIL is AMAZING product, a must have for anyone who has any damage or unmanageable fri

reviews.t: One of my favorite hair products!
reviews.x: I received this in one of the sample boxes I get each month and had to buy the full size. I have naturally curly coarse hair and this leaves it soft and frizz free.  Absolutely love it and will not go without ever again!

reviews.t: Works amazingly on dry, treated hair
reviews.x: I hate to admit it but this stuff is really great.  I have long, stick straight, coarse, Asian hair.  Its been bleached (to pale blond) and then colored (when I got tired of the blond).  And I live in SoCal so I'm in the sun a lot.  My hair can get very dry if its not cared for.  The Black Seed Dry Oil absorbs very quickly and leaves my hair soft, silky and shiny.  I use just a little bit so a 3 fl oz bottle lasts me for months.  I've also tried the hair oil from the Body Shop and the leave-in b

Holy grail product! I bleach my hair at home often and my ends felt like straw no matter what I did. After getting a sample in my boxycharm subscription box I'm hooked! I put put it on my ends after washing my hair and it has totally restored the luster of my hair!

reviews.t: Angry hair is what I got. 😠
reviews.x: It made my hair angry.  Seriously, that's what my hair felt like...it was just angry. I had to rewash it to get it behave again.  I thought it would work great with their awesome flat iron,  but it fell flat.

reviews.t: Adds shine & luster back to dry-dull hair
reviews.x: LOVE, LOVE, LOVE this hair oil.  I bought this for my 8 yr old daughter who has long, curly hair that was getting dull and dry due to her thyroid issue.  This helped to return her hair to a natural shine an luster while we waited for her thyroid meds to hopefully even out her levels. I am now also using occasionally on my hair which is long but thin.  It did not make it flat and limp, like i thought it was going to.  It actually made it feel thicker and fuller?  Which surprised me.  I will conti

reviews.t: This stuff is incredible for laying down fly aways and giving my hair a beautiful shine. A tiny bit of product goes a ..
reviews.x: I am beyond impressed by this product. I tried it this morning to get a sleek Kim K inspired bun. This stuff is incredible for laying down fly aways and giving my hair a beautiful shine. A tiny bit of product goes a long way! It doesn't leave your hair feeling greasy, just soft and shiny. I then used the Kardashian Beauty Pure Glitz Hairspray to finish the look and it also added a slight shine to my hair which was perfect. I just ordered the Volume Foam as well and can't wait to complete my coll

I received a sample in my Boxycharm a couple of months back and absolutely fell in love. My hair is long, thick, damaged and frizzy. This serum gives it great shine, without making it look or feel oily. I could also swear that it gives it volume. I'm not sure how that's possible with a serum, but since I have been using it, my hair has just the right amount of lift at the roots. A little goes a long way and you can't beat the price for something that works miracles. Love. This. Stuff.

reviews.t: This is the best hair oil I have ever used!
reviews.x: This is the best hair oil I have ever used. Everything in the past has been too oily, and weighs my hair down. This stuff makes my hair looks sleek, shiny, and soft, but not oily! It doesn't look wet at all, and it doesn't weigh my hair down. I have used it almost every day for the past 2 weeks, and I will continue to repurchase when I run out!

I am truly surprised this works as well as it does. I bought it on a whim after seeing it in a video and I LOVE it!! I have super course curly hair and I put it in to air dry it curly or when I blow it out straight. It DOES NOT leave that residue either when I straighten it like Biosilk and any other serum I've tried. Overall, great product!!

Absolutely love this product! The very first time I tried it, I was amazed. I used it on my damp hair, and it seriously made it feel like silk, it was so smooth and shiny. The smell isn't particularly bad or strong, but the product does make your hands feel slippery/oily after you put it on - that's the only negative aspect.

reviews.t: Wonderful smell. I use all the Kardashian Beauty hair ...
reviews.x: Wonderful smell. I use all the Kardashian Beauty hair products and my hair smells wonderful throughout the day! I put this oil on my hair before it dries and also put it on dry hair on days I don't wash my hair.
Works as described, although on my very thick, often dry, and totally curly hair it takes a fair amount to achieve the desired effect. Best if applied when hair is wet, although you can do it later.

reviews.t: Great product! Does not make hair look greasy
reviews.x: Great product! Does not make hair look greasy. I use it in my wet hair before drying. If I don't wash my hair, I put a very small amount on the ends when my hair is dry. Love this!
Very cheap product. Did not work- dont buy!. Overly priced!
This is so good, leaves my hair nice n smooth i love it!

I have really think, long hair (#ItalianAndMexicanProblems) but recently drastically lightened my hair. Love the way it looks but in combination with styling- my hair hasn't been feeling the best. I use Olaplex once a week, It's a 10 leave in, AG BB...all good stuff but doesn't keep my hair as soft for very long. I was looking for a finishing serum and ran across this one- the reviews were to pass up. I've been able to use this serum for the last two days after I style my hair; just a pump in a

reviews.t: Makes my hair very soft and shiny
reviews.x: Usually celebrity endorsements for products aren't that great, but I really love this! It's not obnoxiously expensive, and it makes my thick, coarse hair feel fantastic and smooth. It gives it a nice, shiny finish. It smells... kinda weird. It's black seed oil, and the only thing I can describe the scent as is like seeds. It smells kinda natural, which I don't mind. It's not a bad scent, you just have to get used to it. A little bit goes a long way, so I don't think I'll need to buy more anytime

reviews.t: This isn't a moisturizer, it's a serum. If ...
reviews.x: This isn't a moisturizer, it's a serum. If you understand that and you get the difference, then you will think this is a phenomenal tool to have in your hair Arsenal. I use it after I curl my relaxed hair to give it extra shine and I use it on my daughter's natural hair after I spritz her hair with water. I use other products nightly to moisturize and seal, but this does give hair that little bit of oomph in the shine and smooth department.

I was pleasantly surprised by this product.  I have very fine hair with no body and wasn't sure if it would weigh it down.  I don't use too much (about 1/2 a pump) but it really makes my hair shiny.  I use it on towel dried hair.  The scent is just fine -- I don't have a problem with it.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the product for making hair soft, shiny, and silky, with many calling it the best hair oil they've used.
Many reviewers note the oil is lightweight and non-greasy, absorbing into hair without weighing it down or leaving residue.
Several reviewers say it works well on dry, damaged, frizzy, or chemically treated hair, restoring luster and taming frizz.
A recurring theme is that reviewers dislike the Kardashians and feel conflicted about buying the product, yet still recommend it.
One reviewer reports a negative experience, saying the product made their hair feel bad and required re-washing.
